title: AI Building AI: Jeff Dean Leaves Google's Heart to Usher in the Era of 'Unmanned Research' - finance.biggo.com
summary: Jeff Dean leaves Google's AI research division to start a new era of 'unmanned research' where AI systems can independently conduct research without human intervention. This shift is made possible by advancements in AI technology, enabling machines to learn and make decisions on their own. The practical consequence of this development is that AI systems will be able to accelerate scientific discoveries and innovation, potentially leading to breakthroughs in various fields.

title: Google DeepMind uses EVE Online to test advanced AI agents | ETIH EdTech News - EdTech Innovation Hub
summary: Google DeepMind uses EVE Online to test advanced AI agents. The company leverages the massively multiplayer online game to create realistic simulations for training and testing its AI agents, which can learn from complex environments and interact with multiple agents. This development enables Google DeepMind to improve the performance and decision-making capabilities of its AI agents, potentially leading to breakthroughs in areas such as game playing and autonomous systems.
